title: Sean Garrett Launches “Girlfriend” Series & Live Streams on YouTube
htmlContent:
Music isn’t just about what we hear — it’s about what we feel. And few understand that better than Sean Garrett.

The multi-platinum songwriter, producer, and artist is taking fans deeper into the emotional fabric of his latest single, “Girlfriend” featuring Plies and Hunxho, with the launch of the “Girlfriend Series + Live Streams” — a four-part visual journey premiering weekly on YouTube starting Wednesday, July 3, and continuing on July 10, 17, and 24. Each episode will be followed by a live Q&A session at 7 PM ET on both Instagram and YouTube, offering fans an unfiltered look into the raw stories and real-life moments that shaped the song.

A Visual Experience Beyond the Music

The “Girlfriend Series” isn’t your typical music video rollout. It’s an immersive extension of the song’s themes — love, vulnerability, betrayal, and reflection. Each episode serves as a cinematic chapter that peels back the layers of the track, giving life to the emotional complexity behind the lyrics.

By following each video with a live Q&A, Garrett brings fans closer than ever to the heart of his creative process. The interactive format allows audiences to ask questions, hear the backstory, and connect directly with the stories that inspired the music — a rare and intimate invitation into the world of an artist who’s long operated behind the scenes of some of music’s biggest hits.

Meet Sean Garrett: A Legacy in Motion

Few figures in contemporary music hold a résumé as iconic as Sean Garrett. With 56 #1 singles and 18 Billboard Hot 100 chart-toppers, Garrett’s impact as a songwriter and producer is undeniable. He’s penned and produced era-defining hits for Beyoncé (“Check On It”), Usher (“Yeah!”), Fergie (“London Bridge”), Chris Brown, Nicki Minaj, Summer Walker, and many more.

What sets Garrett apart isn’t just his commercial success, but his vision — a talent for blending R&B, pop, hip-hop, and crunk in a way that has helped shape the modern soundscape of the past two decades. Now stepping confidently into the spotlight as a solo artist, Garrett is once again leading by example.

A Mission That Goes Beyond the Charts

Garrett’s passion extends beyond the studio through his philanthropic project, “Amplify Your Music” — an initiative aimed at providing instruments, mentorship, and music education to underserved youth across the country. It’s a mission rooted in the belief that access to creativity can transform lives, particularly in communities where opportunities are often limited.

Released Under Blackground Records 2.0

“Girlfriend” also marks a major moment in Garrett’s creative partnership with Blackground Records 2.0. The reimagined label, initially known for launching the careers of legends like Aaliyah, Timbaland, and JoJo, is now entering a new chapter focused on empowering artists who innovate and inspire.

As one of the flagship talents leading this charge, Garrett is helping define the new identity of Blackground 2.0 — rooted in legacy, driven by evolution.

“Girlfriend” by Sean Garrett featuring Plies and Hunxho is available now on all streaming platforms.

Don’t miss the premiere of the “Girlfriend Series + Live Streams,” starting Wednesday, July 3 on YouTube, with live interactive Q&As every Wednesday at 7 PM ET on Instagram and YouTube.

This summer, get ready to go beyond the music — and straight to the heart.
excerpt: Sean Garrett is taking fans deeper into his new single “Girlfriend” with a four-episode visual series and live Q&As airing on YouTube and Instagram throughout July. The series explores the emotional themes behind the song and offers an intimate look into Garrett’s creative process.
